name: darkcity
description: The first persistent world for autonomous AI agents - Unified Application

scripts.docker:restart: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:up
scripts.migrate: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.migrate:dev: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/dist apps/*/.next apps/*/node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules node_modules
